title: Nitpicker fix plans
description: The fix-plans.json that a comparison run writes beside new-findings.json: one plan for each new enforceable finding of a nitpicker check whose fix needs judgment. A plan is built from the finding, the files of the project and the rule's allowed form. It changes no file and calls no language model; the agent or the person who reads it makes the change.

finding.description: The finding the plan is for, as new-findings.json prints it.

kind.description: The kind of change the plan asks for.

target.description: The code to change: a file or a folder, the function or class when the finding names one, and the lines.

context.description: Only what the kind needs, such as the measured value and the limit, candidate blocks, the uncovered branch, the mutation, the other copy of a duplicate, the import edge or the nearest test file. The fields differ by kind.

steps.description: The steps to take, in order, with the real names of the files and symbols and the allowed form of the rule.

doneWhen.description: When the change is done: the finding that stops being reported.
